food_identity: East-coast surf town combining exceptionally fresh seafood, Sri Lankan rice-and-curry, Tamil/South-Indian food, roti/kottu, vegetarian surf cafés, beach restaurants and hands-on cooking classes.
best_use_cases: fresh-catch dinners,budget local curry,post-surf meals,vegetarian food,beach dining,cooking classes,late-night food
notable_food_areas: Main Street/Panama Road,beachfront,Sinhapura Road,Pottuvil/Arugam Bay fringe
social_insights: Current reviews and community discussions suggest that seafood freshness and surf-town atmosphere are major strengths, while authenticity/spice level can vary between tourist-facing venues. The recommender should separate popularity, freshness, local authenticity, dietary fit and nightlife atmosphere.

food_identity: Quiet Uva hill-country town with strong everyday Sri Lankan rice-and-curry culture, vegetable-forward meals, tea-country identity, family-run eateries, small cafés and a smaller tourism-facing dining scene than Ella.
best_use_cases: authentic local lunch,vegetarian hill-country meals,budget food,tea stops,family dining,slow-travel food experiences
social_insights: Public sources suggest Bandarawela's value is less about a large trendy restaurant scene and more about simple local meals, tea-country context and family-run dining. Recommendation should weight authenticity and value more than review volume.

food_identity: Diverse urban food scene combining everyday rice-and-curry shops, kottu and hopper eateries, Muslim biryani/short-eat culture, Northern/Jaffna restaurants, Burgher lamprais heritage, seafood and modern Sri Lankan restaurants.
best_use_cases: first-time Sri Lankan food discovery,budget local meals,street-food evenings,heritage cuisine,premium seafood
social_insights: Social discussions repeatedly distinguish simple local rice-and-curry places from polished tourist-facing venues; recommendation should therefore consider authenticity preference as well as budget and dietary needs.

food_identity: Gateway to Sri Lanka's Cultural Triangle. Strong for village-style rice & curry, vegetable curries, breakfast dishes and hotel buffets near Kandalama.
best_use_cases: After cave temple visit, family dining, authentic meals
social_insights: Authentic village restaurants are generally preferred over tourist buffets for local cuisine.

food_identity: Hill-country tourist town where home-style Sri Lankan rice-and-curry, kottu, hoppers and vegetable curries coexist with a dense cafe and international-food scene. Tea culture, vegetarian/vegan demand and cooking experiences are especially relevant.
best_use_cases: authentic home-style meals,budget local food,vegetarian/vegan travel,tea experiences,cooking classes,late-night mixed-group dining
notable_food_areas: Ella Main Street/A23,near the railway tunnel,Passara Road,Kithal Ella
social_insights: Public discussions explicitly distinguish tourist-facing central restaurants from more local/home-style choices. Therefore the recommender should model authenticity preference and avoid equating popularity with local authenticity.

food_identity: Southern coastal food destination combining fresh-catch seafood, beach BBQ, home-style Sri Lankan rice-and-curry, roti/kottu shops, cooking experiences and a large tourism-oriented cafe/bar scene.
best_use_cases: fresh seafood dinners,budget local curries,roti/kottu,beach dining,cooking classes,vegetarian breakfast
notable_food_areas: Mirissa Beach,Udupila/inland Mirissa,Bandaramulla,central A2/Galle Road corridor
social_insights: Popularity and beachfront location often correlate with tourist orientation, while home-style curry and roti shops can offer stronger local-food signals. The recommender should keep authenticity, atmosphere, price and popularity as separate dimensions.

food_identity: Rural Cultural Triangle food scene centered on home-style rice-and-curry, village vegetable curries, roti, fresh juices and increasingly popular hands-on cooking classes. Tourist-facing hotel dining exists, but many highly rated small restaurants remain budget-oriented.
best_use_cases: authentic village meals,budget curry,vegetarian food,cooking classes,post-Sigiriya-climb meals,family dining
notable_food_areas: Hotel Road/lake area,Sigiriya village centre,Udupila-style village roads,hotel zone near Lion Rock
social_insights: Current reviews and travel discussions suggest Sigiriya is especially strong for small curry restaurants and cooking experiences. The recommender should separately model authenticity, tourist adaptation/spice level, scenic value and family suitability.

food_identity: Safari destination known for hotel buffets, seafood, village rice & curry and meals around Tissamaharama/Kirinda.
social_insights: Fresh seafood and authentic village food complement safari tourism.
